question: Which of the following books was longlisted for the Booker Prize 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__China Room.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China Room **was longlisted for the Booker Prize Award 2021.
 
• The Writer of **China Room **is **Sunjeev Sahota.**
 
• “China Room” refers to a room at the back of a village home in Punjab, India, in the year1929.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Important Novel Written by Sunjeev Sahota.**__

 __
